name: Stadtkino Wien
notes: single-screen arthouse cinema; /programm/dat/YYYYMMDD/ returns a rolling 3-day window (columns for date, date+1, date+2, empty ones render as bare <div>), tiled by stepping 3 days; year not printed in markup so start dates are computed from the requested offset, not parsed text; price never published anywhere (incl. JS ticket booking app) so price_min/price_text always null; category not published either; 'Geschlossene Veranstaltung' (private closed screenings) skipped as non-public; site was in summer break (Sommerpause 23.7-19.8) at scrape time, program otherwise published out to ~90 days (into November)
